The background shows a wooden restaurant interior. (3) A screen recording shows a digital menu interface with text indicating a price of $299 for all-you-can-eat dumplings. (14) The man with glasses is shown eating a green dumpling, followed by several close-ups of dumplings topped with chili sauce being lifted with a spoon.
